name: gizza-ai/data-uri-encode
summary: Build a data: URI from text with a chosen MIME type and Base64 or percent encoding.

tool.description: Build a self-contained 'data:' URI (RFC 2397) from text, for inline embedding in CSS url(...), an , a JSON payload, or an email. Pass the content as 'text', the media type as 'mime' (default 'text/plain'), and 'encoding' as 'base64' (default) or 'url'. Returns the data: URI plus its mime, encoding, input byte count, and URI length.
